# SectionHeader

The opening of every section: a mono eyebrow led by the red step mark, a condensed uppercase title and an optional lead and action.

## Use
- `.rg-section-head` > `.rg-section-head__text` (`span.rg-eyebrow` with `span.rg-step-mark`, an `h2.t-h1` or `h2.t-h2`, optional `p.t-lead`) + an optional `.rg-textlink` or small button, aligned to the bottom right.
- `.rg-section-head--center` for short headers between full-width blocks (process, CTA). Centre only the header, never body text.
- The step mark is the system's signature: three rising treads in `highlight`. It leads every eyebrow, and nothing else uses it as a bullet.
- Eyebrows name the section in one or two words: **Realisaties**, **Werkwijze**, **Over Raf**, **Contact**, **Veelgestelde vragen**.
- One `.rg-accent-word` per title at most.
- Leave `space-2xl` between the header and the content (built in).
